user.title: Connect Xinelum
user.description: Paste a web address from the Xinelum app. You find it in the app in the Automation tab under Fernstart per Webadresse: switch it on, then touch and hold an address to copy it. Home Assistant talks to the app directly on your local network, without a broker and without any server in between.

data_description.adresse: For example http://192.168.178.20:47474/xinelum/…/starten. Any of the three addresses works.

zeroconf_bestaetigen.title: Xinelum found
zeroconf_bestaetigen.description: Xinelum is answering at {host}. Paste a web address from the app to finish.

data_description.adresse: In the Xinelum app in the Automation tab under Fernstart per Webadresse.

reauth_confirm.title: Xinelum no longer accepts the key
reauth_confirm.description: Xinelum at {host} no longer accepts the stored key. If it was renewed in the app, paste the new web address.

data_description.adresse: In the Xinelum app in the Automation tab under Fernstart per Webadresse.

error.adresse_unlesbar: This is not a Xinelum web address. Copy it in the app in the Automation tab under Fernstart per Webadresse.
error.nicht_erreichbar: Nothing answers at this address. Is Xinelum open on the device that runs the cinema, and is Fernstart per Webadresse switched on?
error.abgelehnt: Xinelum answers but does not accept this key. Copy the web address from the app again.
error.ruht: Xinelum is running on this device but is not running the cinema right now. Use the address of the device that runs the cinema, ideally the Mac.
error.nicht_freigeschaltet: Xinelum shares the cinema state only with the purchase „Erweiterte Smarthome-Anbindung“ (advanced smart home connection) or with Xinelum+. Both are in the Xinelum app under Extensions. The integration itself stays free.
error.unbekannte_antwort: Something answers at this address, but it is not Xinelum.

nicht_freigeschaltet.title: Xinelum no longer delivers data
nicht_freigeschaltet.description: Xinelum at {adresse} no longer shares the cinema state. Until the purchase „Erweiterte Smarthome-Anbindung“ or Xinelum+ is valid again, all entities stay unavailable. Both are in the Xinelum app under Extensions.
